terra.problem: The claim that you can only see God’s protection by looking back is an unsupported restriction. The passage shows Jacob recognizing God’s past protection, but does not say that is the only way to see it.

Saying Jacob kept Laban in the dark ‘about the whole thing’ immediately after mentioning Rachel’s theft could imply that Jacob knew about the stolen idols. The passage says he concealed his departure; Genesis 31:32 says he did not know Rachel had stolen them.
